newsitem.title: POLAND: Holiday Inn to open 20 hotels in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Holiday Inn to open 20 hotels in Poland.

text.p: Holiday Inn Worldwide, a unit of brewing and leisure firm Bass Plc., has signed a franchise deal with a Polish group to develop 20 hotels in Poland within 10 years, Holiday Inn's official said on Thursday.

Reas Kondraschow, Holiday's Inn vice-president for regional development, told a news conference Holiday Inn planned to double its hotels in Europe, Africa and the Middle East to about 500 in the year 2000.
Holiday Inn at present franchises one hotel in Warsaw. Kondraschow declined to say whether Holiday Inn would enter Poland as an hotel owner.
Under the agreement, Holiday Inn will lend its expertise and brand name to the hotels developed by Global Hotel Development Group (GHDG) in return for about four percent of their revenues.
GHGD, a group of Polish investors including EuroDollar Poland car renting company, plans to build about 10 hotels by itself, GHDG president Marceli Krol said.
He said his firm wanted to draw other hotel builders or owners into developing the remaining 10 Holiday Inn hotels.
GHDG is in talks with Amerbank and Polish capital groups on financing the projects, he said without elaborating.
He said that out of the 20, about 10 would be economy-class Holiday Inn Express hotels, where prices are the lowest. The first hotel will be built in the southern city of Gliwice by the year 1999.
The contruction of a typical Holiday Inn Express hotel costs about $5 million. Hotels of other types are more expensive, depending on standards and the number of rooms.
